title: Fix CI black check failure for generated LuaParserVisitor

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Reproduced CI failure locally: black --check requested reformat for tactus/validation/generated/LuaParserVisitor.py. Fixed by formatting that file and updating generation pipeline/docs so visitor formatting runs as part of make generate-python-parser. Validation: black --check tactus/ tests/ features/steps/ passed; ruff check tactus/ tests/ features/steps/ passed.
